evidence: We need to take an honest look at how the team is performing.

output.teacher_note: 这句话先承认团队在局部有亮点，再用 but 转折指出整体交付不稳定。记忆时抓住“pockets of + 优点”与“struggles to + 目标”的对比框架。

reusable_patterns.template: [team] has pockets of [strength] in [area], but it still struggles to [goal].

slots.team: 把 team 换成具体团队或组织
slots.strength: 把 strength 换成具体优势，如 talent、quality
slots.area: 把 area 换成具体领域，如 design、marketing
slots.goal: 把 goal 换成具体目标，如 deliver consistently、scale

reusable_patterns.rationale: 替换团队、优势、领域和目标，保留“局部有亮点但整体有困难”的对比结构。
